_comment: Reconciled to the mature nested manifest shape kart-identity-service/kart-inventory-service/kart-category-service already use (exchanges[]/externalExchanges[]/publishedEvents[]/queues[with deadLetter+retryLadder]/deadLetterQueues[]), superseding this file's earlier flatter shape (exchange/dlx/queues/dlqs/retry as siblings). Two queues: 'product.review-events.queue' consumes review.exchange's ReviewSubmitted/ReviewUpdated (ratingSummary-only projection, ticket PRD-6, 2x retry per event-contract.md) — one queue/DLQ for both routing keys since both are the same consumer group (this service), matching kart-inventory-service's own 'inventory.order-events.queue' precedent of bundling multiple related external routing keys under one queue/DLQ. 'product.catalog-projection.queue' is this service's own self-consumption of the four events it publishes onto product.exchange, so the write-side (PostgreSQL) to read-side (MongoDB product_read_model) sync flows through the same manifest-driven topology/retry-ladder/DLQ machinery as any other consumer, instead of a bespoke in-process sync path. Search/Recommendation/Wishlist/Offer/Analytics each bind their own separate per-consumer-group queue to product.exchange — not shown here, since a manifest only ever declares the exchanges/queues this service itself owns and directly interacts with (see kart-category-service/contracts/message-bus-manifest.json's identical convention).
